AI Chief Of Staff

Tend is a personal AI agent you text. No new app: it lives in iMessage or SMS and works inside your own accounts: Gmail, calendar, Shopify, QuickBooks, HubSpot. It replies to email in your voice, books tables, fills your cart, makes phone calls, finds leads and builds your website. The difference: nothing is sent, bought or changed without your yes, and what it learns about you sits in a Brain you can read and correct. It also texts you first with reminders, price watches and flight updates.

What Tend learns about you goes into your “Brain,” a memory you can read and correct. Tend can also text you first when something you’ve asked it to monitor happens like an email reply arriving, a price dropping, or a flight changing. We’re invite-only during early access. Sign in at heytend.me with your phone number to request access, and tell me in the comments: What’s the first task you’d hand to Tend? [...] Hi everyone! I’m Hritvik, founder of Tend. Most AI assistants tell you what to do—but leave you to do the work. You still have to open the app, find the email, fill the cart, or make the call. I wanted an assistant you could text like a person, one that could actually get things done in your own accounts. That’s why we built Tend. It works through iMessage and SMS. Sign in with your phone number, connect the accounts you want it to work with—Gmail, your calendar, Shopify, QuickBooks, or HubSpot—and text it a task: “Reply to Dana that Thursday works.” “Find me a flight to Austin on the 3rd.” “What sold today?” “Find me 10 leads and draft outreach emails.” Two principles guide everything Tend does: You stay in control. Nothing is sent, purchased, booked, or changed without your approval.

Are you seeing early users lean on Plander more for personal projects or side hustles?

•1 review

I've been testing Plander.ai for my personal project management and I'm quite impressed with its AI-powered approach. The way it breaks down complex goals into actionable steps is really helpful - saves me a lot of time that I used to spend on manual planning. The calendar integration works smoothly and I love how it adapts when my priorities change. The interface is clean and intuitive, though I'd love to see more customization options for the task views. Compared to traditional project management tools, this feels more like having a smart assistant that actually understands context. It's still early days for the product, but the potential is definitely there. Great work on the launch! 🚀
